name: wildbotics-marp-template
description: Marp theme for WildBotics slides, in the style of the Bristol Flight Lab template

scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build:files && marp example/slides.md -o dist/slides.html
scripts.pdf: npm run build:theme && marp example/slides.md -o dist/slides.pdf
scripts.pptx: npm run build:theme && marp example/slides.md -o dist/slides.pptx
scripts.png: npm run build:theme && marp example/slides.md --images png -o dist/slides.png
scripts.watch: npm run build:theme && npm run build:files && marp -w example/slides.md -o dist/slides.html
